heading: Recommendation
rationale: Bean 55ao. The statement an L1 guidance document exists to make: cited, traced to and signed off one at a time, so labelled like a theorem, but proved by nothing; its authority is the issuing body's. `prefixEnforced: false` on the owner's ruling (2026-09-23, Q1): the FOLIO chooses its label grammar, so `rec` is recognised and never required. Strength is a code in a declared code list (Q2, see code-lists/); a link to a DAK health-intervention is the optional `about` edge, never a merge (Q3, 2026-10-06). No DoCO co-type: none is unambiguously right for a normative statement. Typed by cat-harness as `RecommendationBlock`.
